rawContent: Join #MiamiLaw and @UMHOPE on 10/14 for "Lawyering for Racial Equity." This virtual event explores how the #BLM movement connects to the work students are doing in clinics & externships, and shares practical #racialequity tools. Register at https://t.co/2IS8zO7Ttt https://t.co/YXkvtshbdy

#COVID19 has highlighted privilege disparities & the inequities navigating #climatechange mitigation. Abigail Fleming, #MiamiLaw's Freedman Foundation Practitioner in Residence, walks us through what needs to change on the Miami Law Explainer podcast: https://t.co/cnfPOAbmIu https://t.co/XDINLaC4iT
